# My Internship Notebook

> A free, private, notebook-style web app for organizing internship applications, interviews,
> deadlines, and offers. Installs like an app on a phone, laptop, or desktop and works offline.

Each application gets its own page for notes, contacts, and next steps. A board view tracks
the pipeline (Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected), and an insights view summarizes
response rate, interview rate, and weekly activity against a personal goal.

Entries are stored only in the visitor's own browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server, and
nothing about a visitor's applications is ever readable by anyone else, including the people
who made this site. There is no account, no login, and no tracking of application content.
A visitor's data does not currently sync between their own devices; a manual backup-file
export/import is available for moving a notebook to another device.

The source code is plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with no third-party runtime dependencies
and no build step, plus an optional Java backend for a local-only, single-user version.

- [Source code](https://github.com/will-iam08/internship-notebook): the full, public source repository
- [Live app](https://internshipnotebook.app/): the app itself, not a marketing page
